video_title: Training Camp Media Availability | October 2, 2026 | OKC Thunder

quotes.speaker: Alex Caruso
quotes.summary_phrase: Alex Caruso on the intensity of training camp and foul frequency
quotes.excerpt: most camps, if not everybody, there's more fouls than defense being played just because of getting in the routine
quotes.quote: I'm sure like most camps, if not everybody, there's more fouls than defense being played just because of getting in the routine of playing full speed, guarding without using hands, and just getting up to the timing of stuff.
quotes.social_post: Alex Caruso on the early stages of Thunder training camp: there is more fouls than defense being played right now as the team gets into the routine of playing full speed.

quotes.speaker: Alex Caruso
quotes.summary_phrase: Alex Caruso on Kenrich Williams' competitive leadership
quotes.excerpt: Kenrich Williams is one of the competitive leaders on this team. Every time he plays, he's trying to win.
quotes.quote: Kenrich Williams is one of the competitive leaders on this team. Every time he plays, he's trying to win and he comes with a certain intensity that the game requires if you want to win and play at a high level.
quotes.social_post: Alex Caruso highlights Kenrich Williams as a key competitive leader for the Thunder, noting he brings the intensity required to play at a high level.

quotes.speaker: Alex Caruso
quotes.summary_phrase: Alex Caruso on Kenrich Williams' versatility and defensive impact
quotes.excerpt: Kenrich Williams is a pretty complete basketball player. He was all-defensive team member as well as all-NBA.
quotes.quote: Kenrich Williams is a pretty complete basketball player. He was all-defensive team member as well as all-NBA that year that he played the full year for us. Just getting a versatile player back, that's something I think in the current age of basketball, the state of the game, you need guys that can do a little bit of everything and he does a little bit of everything at a very high level.
quotes.social_post: Alex Caruso calls Kenrich Williams a complete basketball player, emphasizing that his versatility is exactly what is needed in the current state of the NBA.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams on his growth and understanding of defensive principles
quotes.excerpt: I feel like when I came, I learned the endings of all the plays. Now I can learn the base.
quotes.quote: I feel like when I came, I learned the endings of all the plays. Now I can learn the base of all plays and defensive principles and how we want to guard stuff and how we want to do stuff offensively. So it's been really nice to be in a real training camp.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Williams says he is focused on learning the base of defensive principles and team schemes during this training camp compared to his rookie experience.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams on playing with speed on the defensive end
quotes.excerpt: We want to play fast, we want to get on run and when we're able to get turnovers and stops.
quotes.quote: We want to play fast, we want to get on run and when we're able to get turnovers and stops, we're able to run and that's I feel that's our bread and butter, getting out in transition and I can run the floor, get those open threes when they collapse on a dub or a shake for a layup.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Williams says the Thunder bread and butter is getting out in transition off turnovers and stops to create open looks.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams on Kenrich Williams' professionalism and vocal leadership
quotes.excerpt: He's a professional on and off the court. He's very vocal out there for me especially.
quotes.quote: He's a professional on and off the court. He's very vocal out there for me especially and for all the young guys, I'm sure. Just being able to ask him any questions and he's obviously a very competitive guy so we always go back and forth.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Williams credits Kenrich Williams for being a vocal leader and a professional who is always available to answer questions for the younger players.

quotes.speaker: Jalen Williams
quotes.summary_phrase: Jalen Williams on the rookies' ability to read the game
quotes.excerpt: Bennett is a really good, just complete. He can read the game really well.
quotes.quote: Bennett is a really good, just complete. He can read the game really well. He's able to come off screens, make the right decision. Adama can obviously rim run. He's obviously so he's what seven whatever, so being able to affect the game like that is going to be huge for us to play.
quotes.social_post: Jalen Williams is impressed with the rookies, noting that Bennett reads the game well and Adama provides a rim-running presence that will be huge for the team.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on Alex Caruso's defensive limitations and competitive motor
quotes.excerpt: He's done a great job because he's obviously got limitations because of his size.
quotes.quote: He's done a great job because he's obviously got limitations because of his size and that's fine in the NBA. It's a team game. You don't need people to be on an island. We all help each other, but you got to execute, you got to play with a motor, you got to be competitive and he's got all that stuff and a great base of strength.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault on Alex Caruso: he has limitations due to his size, but he compensates with a great base of strength, a high motor, and a competitive nature.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on the team's possession-based approach to winning
quotes.excerpt: We just we always look at things on a possession basis. The games are made up of possessions.
quotes.quote: We just we always look at things on a possession basis. The games are made up of possessions and to win a game you have to win possessions and to win the possessions you got to win the little fundamental battles that are happening every possession in a basketball game.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault on the Thunder philosophy: we always look at things on a possession basis because winning a game requires winning the little fundamental battles every possession.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on the young players' progress in training camp
quotes.excerpt: A young player that's never been in an NBA camp and never played with this type of speed.
quotes.quote: A young player that's never been in an NBA camp and never played with this type of speed and length and athleticism, they can get better in four days and all those guys did. They've taken a great approach to it. They're not perfect, they have a long way to go fundamentally, but they're off to a great start because they're competitive, they're team guys, and they're focused on the right things right now.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault says the young players have made significant progress in just four days of training camp, praising their competitiveness and focus.

quotes.speaker: Mark Daigneault
quotes.summary_phrase: Mark Daigneault on Alex Caruso's elite pick-and-roll defensive processing
quotes.excerpt: His processing in pick-and-roll defense is top of the line. There's no one I've been around.
quotes.quote: His processing in pick-and-roll defense is top of the line. There's no one I've been around that does it quite like him. And then on the other end of the floor, he's a masterful screen setter that really curates his screen setting to who he's playing with.
quotes.social_post: Mark Daigneault says Alex Caruso has top of the line processing in pick and roll defense and is a masterful screen setter who curates his game to his teammates.
